title: Smoked Fish Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish with a smoky twist. This recipe combines the flavors of smoked fish with the rich spices of a tagine.

ingredients.name: Smoked Fish
ingredients.notes: Look for smoked fish with a firm texture and a mild flavor

ingredients.name: Algerian Fish Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: You can also use a combination of paprika, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon as a substitute

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion into small pieces for easy cooking

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a punch of flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the carrots into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Chicken Broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds a bright flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley adds a fresh flavor and a pop of color

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the smoked fish to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it's lightly browned.
Add the Algerian fish spice blend, chicken broth, and lemon juice to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Season the dish with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the smoked fish tagine hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a dollop of yogurt (optional).
